overview.startPoint: Find the damaged device while raiding the 18-22 furnished floors of Daemonheim, then ask Skaldrun south-west of the Daemonheim entrance to share their story.

questReqs.text: Find and free Skaldrun from the frozen floors in Daemonheim

followsEvents: Ability to enter the Warriors' Guild
A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen
A Fairy Tale I - Growing Pains…

notes: This guide is for 100% completion and to receive the unabridged tome. Having audio turned on helps. You cannot switch it during the quest so it is recommended to turn all audio on beforehand.

blocks.html: Start by finding a damaged device on Daemonheim floors 18-22.

substeps.html: You might need to talk to Skaldrun to check whether the Nadir saga is already unlocked.

blocks.html: Then start saga with Skaldrun south-west of the Daemonheim entrance.

blocks.html: Finish the dialogue and cutscene then continue north to interrogate the merchant.

blocks.html: Hunt for 3 memories (having sound turned on helps a lot here).
blocks.text: Hunt for 3 memories (having sound turned on helps a lot here).

substeps.html: Move your mouse around until the orange circle rapidly pulses THREE times per second on a location, and click, as this is a correct spot. There are three speeds--you want to click at the fastest, highest-pitched ping. Repeat until all three memories are recovered.
substeps.text: Move your mouse around until the orange circle rapidly pulses THREE times per second on a location, and click, as this is a correct spot. There are three speeds--you want to click at the fastest, highest-pitched ping. Repeat until all three memories are recovered.

substeps.html: If only half the memory is recovered, you did not do this step correctly and as a result an unabridged tome will not be awarded, you can lobby to restart the saga.
substeps.text: If only half the memory is recovered, you did not do this step correctly and as a result an unabridged tome will not be awarded, you can lobby to restart the saga.

substeps.html: A pinging sound will play if game sounds are turned on: a slow hum (level 1), a moderately fast ping (level 2, indicating you are close to the correct position), and a fast, high-frequency ping that plays ~2 times a second. This is the correct location for full memory retrieval.
substeps.text: A pinging sound will play if game sounds are turned on: a slow hum (level 1), a moderately fast ping (level 2, indicating you are close to the correct position), and a fast, high-frequency ping that plays ~2 times a second. This is the correct location for full memory retrieval.

substeps.html: The correct location does not always correspond to the centre of a memory you can see. It can also be an empty space.

blocks.html:
The questions posed by soldiers and necrolords must be answered correctly to get 100% completion of the saga. The order of the answers is randomised for each playthrough, so take care to read them and select the right one.
The correct options do not appear if the memory puzzle has not been completed perfectly.
Head north through the door and about half way into the room to get a dialogue interface, then leave the same way.
blocks.text: Head north through the door and about half way into the room to get a dialogue interface, then leave the same way.

The Persistent Rage relic power will recharge your adrenaline if you are out of combat. Select a spell to autocast.
